facts.text: High chandeliered ceilings, hand-painted silk murals and lush gardens give the hotel a feeling of sanctuary in the city.
facts.excerpt: High chandeliered ceilings, hand-painted silk murals and lush gardens provide a feeling of sanctuary in this city that never sleeps.

facts.text: The skytrain is just steps from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Venture out and explore, with the skytrain just steps away.

facts.text: Guests can walk to Bangkok's most exclusive malls, just around the corner.
facts.excerpt: Wander on foot to Bangkok's most exclusive malls, just around the corner.

facts.text: Rooms offer classic Thai style with hand-painted murals or a more contemporary take.

facts.text: Rooms have a marble bathroom with a separate tub and rain shower.

facts.text: All suite guests enjoy Kasara privileges.

facts.text: Accommodation includes the Garden Pool Villa with a private pool and the Two Bedroom Jim Thompson Explorer Suite.

facts.text: The building opened in 1982 as a Peninsula, later operated as a Regent and a Four Seasons, and became Anantara's flagship in 2015 after extensive renovations.
